veranderings.voor: met die eerstehulpsak in haar hand
veranderings.na: met die noodhulpsak in haar hand
veranderings.rede: 'Eerstehulp' copies English 'first aid'; the standard Afrikaans term is 'noodhulp', and it keeps the same word count.

vlae.teks: Daarna plak sy 'n pleister oor die plek en sê Thandi moet eers 'n ruk sit.
vlae.rede: Two paragraphs earlier 'sê Thandi' is a speech tag (Thandi speaking), so a Grade 4 reader may read 'en sê Thandi' here as Thandi talking. 'en sê dat Thandi eers 'n ruk moet sit' would be clearer, but it adds a word and the text is over its ceiling, so I flag it and do not propose it.
